notes: The envelope the engine writes before spawning a dir: node worker. autonomy attended is the tier that denies push, merge and PR creation, which is what the permissions block renders. outbox is the only cross-directory write the worker is granted. The two documents differ in what a dispatch is about: one carries no ticket, because its run records none; the other carries the ticket its run was started from, which is how a chain finds its own earlier dispatches for a ticket without reading a statement.
